svg.title: Reefguard Barracks — Reefguard boathouse, bunk rafts and practice decks
svg.desc: A thatched reefguard boathouse overlooks the drill lagoon. Hammock bunks, spiral practice banners and shell-carved footlockers lead to rope-linked observation decks.
svg.text: Reefguard boathouse, bunk rafts and practice decks
A thatched reefguard boathouse overlooks the drill lagoon. Hammock bunks, spiral practice banners and shell-
carved footlockers lead to rope-linked observation decks.
Shell · kelp rope · sea glass · driftwood · verdigris bronze
